name: Structured Data Analysis
description: Inspect columns and types, and write an artifact only when one was requested.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the persisted document back as text.
Read a source file that is already in the project.
Persist the document through the registered document tool.
Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Persist text or data when a document type is not required.

validation.rule: Columns and types are cited from a read result. Calculated results are labeled separately from source values. A file exists only when its artifactId was persisted and read back.
